question: In which year was the first Cricket World Cup held in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1987**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **1987** was the year when the first Cricket World Cup was held in India.
 
• This tournament was part of the **Reliance World Cup**, which was co-hosted by India and Pakistan.
 
• It was the fourth edition of the **Cricket World Cup** and the first to be held outside England.
 
• The tournament took place from **October 8 to November 8, 1987**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **1987 Cricket World Cup** was notable for being the first World Cup where matches were reduced to **50 overs per side** instead of the previous 60 overs.
 
• The final was held at **Eden Gardens** in Kolkata, where Australia won their first World Cup by defeating England by **7 runs**.
 
• The introduction of the **neutral umpires** in this tournament was a significant step towards ensuring fair play.
 
• The tournament saw participation from **eight teams**, including the **West Indies, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, England, Australia, New Zealand, India, and Zimbabwe**.
